summary.intent: Get oriented in the caliper repo, commit the uncommitted tool-config changes so they aren't lost, and prepare a proper first release by adapting to the latest callisto (0.11.0) after reading its docs and the last 3 weeks of PRs.
summary.outcome: Surveyed repo status, callisto docs/release notes and recent PRs, and produced a release plan; nothing was committed or changed. Work is paused awaiting user decisions on the first release version (0.1.0 vs 0.2.0) and which uncommitted changes to commit.

repo: Caliper is a Rust/OXC replacement for react-docgen-typescript; core extraction, resolver, CLI, NAPI binding and Vite plugin are done, and the active work is the opt-in TypeScript 7 type-checker backend (tsc-client crate, ADR 0006).

The local checkout can be stale: local main was 8 commits behind origin/main, so the 0.8.0 callisto pins seen locally were already fixed to 0.10.0 on origin (PR #20). Fetch before drawing conclusions.

Nothing has ever been released: no version tags exist and all packages are at 0.1.0. Callisto releases any package whose current version has no tag, so release PR #22 (bumping to 0.1.1) is a leftover from the changesets and would skip 0.1.0.

Callisto 0.11.0 is out while origin pins 0.10.0 and the local mise shim is 0.5.0. Notes for 0.9-0.11 show no breaking change for this config: 0.9 made release intent schema v4 and publishes napi platform packages with their owner, and 0.10.3/0.11.0 add rerun fixes after failed tag pushes, builds only for released packages, and a stop on malformed workspace manifests.

8 changesets exist, all patches. The tsc-client crate (1f0be33) has no changeset and may need publish = false or a callisto.toml entry. TOON, the LSP scaffold, plugins and the schema export predate the last 3 weeks and are covered by no changeset.
Package.json repo URLs on origin still point to oxc-react-docgen while NPM_CONFIG_PROVENANCE is on, so the uncommitted URL fix to 'caliper' matters for npm provenance publishing.

The uncommitted tool-config changes look like an `entire` regeneration: .claude/settings.json drops the Read(./.entire/metadata/**) deny rule and empties enabledPlugins (removing 8 orin-dx-agent-plugins entries), .gemini/settings.json loses all 136 hook lines, while .codex/hooks.json and .github/hooks/entire.json look fine.

code.finding: Comment still says 'Pinned to callisto 0.8.0' in the local stale checkout, whereas origin pins 0.10.0.
The callisto-validate step had a stale callisto pin locally; commit 3f27029 already fixed it on origin.
Last updated 2026-09-28; reports 545 Rust tests and 36 vitest tests all green (not re-verified). Says the tsc --api process lifecycle (crash/restart/timeout) has not started.

workflow: Check `git fetch` and local-vs-origin divergence before reporting repo state or stale pins.
Tool-config regenerations can silently delete deny rules and plugin lists, so review diffs before committing them for the team.
Keep unrelated uncommitted changes (tool config, package.json URL fix, README) in separate commits or branches.

friction: Earlier claim that callisto pins were 0.8.0 was wrong because the local checkout was stale; it had to be corrected after fetching.
The user's recollection of being blocked on callisto could not be confirmed from the repo, and prior session context was unavailable.
CI on main is red: Coverage and Test / Rust fail with an install-action error, and the 3 newest dependabot PRs fail too. The cause has not been diagnosed.
Local mise shim for callisto is 0.5.0, far behind 0.11.0.
The user did not answer the earlier choice about handling .claude and .gemini changes, so tool-config commits are still pending.
open_items: Decide first release version: 0.1.0 (delete changesets) or 0.2.0 (add a minor changeset for the feature set; recommended).
Decide which uncommitted changes to commit (URL fix, .codex/.github hooks) and what to do with .claude and .gemini (restore deny rule and enabledPlugins, verify .gemini).
Pull origin/main, branch, and bump callisto pins to 0.11.0 in release.yml, ci.yml and the callisto.toml comment.
Add a changeset for the features and decide how to handle the tsc-client crate (publish = false or callisto.toml entry).
Diagnose and fix the install-action CI failure on main before releasing.
Land the package.json repo URL fix (oxc-react-docgen -> caliper); the other 17 modified files were not individually reviewed.
Run `callisto release --dry-run` and `status --check` on 0.11.0, then merge the release PR (closing or superseding stale PR #22).
Dependabot PRs #27, #30, #31 and #32 are open and unmerged.
Implement the tsc --api lifecycle (crash, restart, timeout) and the ADR 0006 semantic backend, which are needed to close known gaps like conditional types and mapped types over unbound generics.
